notes.zh-CN: 新增 MiMo Code CLI（mimo）ACP 集成；任务完成通知在后台结束时通过飞书机器人推送至手机端；优化手机端会话同步与展示。macOS 为通用包；Windows 为未签名安装包；APK 为调试签名，IPA 为开发签名（仅限团队已注册设备）。
notes.en: Added MiMo Code CLI (mimo) ACP integration; task-completion notifications now also mirror to mobile via the connected Feishu bot when GrokX is in the background; improved mobile session sync and display. macOS ships universal; Windows installers are unsigned; the APK is debug-signed and the IPA is development-signed (registered team devices only).
